text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's composition alone is close to statistically meaningless. Municipal planning, HR and elected-official pools are heavily female; four-woman panels assemble routinely by chance. Raising it would also signal that you read a loss as bias, which is the fastest way to burn a reference and your reputation in a small professional world.

Also consider the merits: a director of planning spends their time in council chambers and hostile public meetings. "Extensive public consultation experience" is not a soft credential for that job — it may be the core one. Degrees and licences matter less at director level than political judgement.

Do chase the written explanation — politely, in writing, to HR. Ask what you'd need to be competitive next time.
